sourceTitleEnglish: Make a plan everyone can do
sourceObjectiveEnglish: Make a plan everyone can do: Poder changes o to ue except in nosotros: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden.
sourceFocusEnglish: Make a plan everyone can do
sourceSpeakingEnglish: Role-play Un sábado libre with a patient classmate. Practice make a plan everyone can do. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

sourceGrammarEnglish.focus: Poder changes o to ue except in nosotros: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden. The next verb stays in the infinitive: puedo hablar.

examples.en: I want to go to the museum.

examples.es: Julia puede venir por la mañana.
examples.en: Julia can come in the morning.

cards.decisionNote: Spanish el marks masculine singular; French le also elides before a vowel. Contextual article forms need review.
Spanish la groups definite article and feminine object pronouns; French la needs role and elision context.
Source en groups in/on/at. One isolated French answer would erase place and time contrasts.
Spanish las is feminine plural article/object; French les is gender-neutral and can be article or object pronoun.
Source para groups for and purpose. French pour needs object versus infinitive context.
Source de groups of/from; French de requires phrase-level sense and contraction decisions.
Source no groups no and not. French non versus ne…pas depends on the utterance.

reader.decisionNote: French aider pour les devoirs is a conditional idiom choice for help with homework.

reader.sourceSpanish: No pueden comer en esta sala.
reader.sourceEnglish: They cannot eat in this room.
reader.proposedFrench: Ils ne peuvent pas manger dans cette salle.
reader.decisionNote: Spanish pueden does not identify gender; French ils introduces a gender default requiring a source/context decision.

reader.sourceEnglish: Can you repeat the question, please?
reader.proposedFrench: Pouvez-vous répéter la question, s’il vous plaît ?
reader.decisionNote: Spanish puede can be polite usted or third person; polite vous is inferred from please and needs review.

archivedRedesign.title: Négocier un projet de groupe réalisable
archivedRedesign.scene: Un groupe doit préparer une présentation. Une première heure exclut un membre et la salle voulue n’est pas libre.
archivedRedesign.reason: The archived group-presentation meeting, room permission and fallback library differ from the source free-Saturday museum/park/table plan.

sourceDecisions: The pinned Spanish objective teaches poder stem change o→ue except nosotros; French pouvoir has its own irregular paradigm and must be authored as a French objective rather than copied.
The source places a beginner ability-and-planning lesson at Master 12; qualified curriculum review must decide stage placement without changing saved identity silently.
Grouped articles, pronouns, prepositions and no/not require contextual dictionary senses; masculine/feminine information in Spanish may not survive identical French forms.
The source Reader alternates informal puedes, ambiguous puede and unspecified third-person plural pueden; French register and gender choices need review before selection.
